Daily table

Namshi marketplaces only (namshi, namshi_v2), lines with GMV above zero. LFL date compares each day with its like-for-like day from the LFL mapping (for example Black Friday 2026 vs Black Friday 2025); where the mapping gives an LLY date in the wrong year (30 Sep and 31 Dec) the same calendar date is used. Beauty = products with business unit “beauty”. Brand, category and sub-category come from the product catalogue (item_d); “(none)” means the field is blank there. Target = daily GMV plan for the Beauty pod (planning_dod_merch_brand_category_targets, pod cp_beauty), set by country, brand and category; it follows the Category and Brand filters and is hidden when a Sub-category is selected. Targets are loaded up to 31 Oct 2026 so far. GMV includes VAT and all item statuses (including cancelled and returned). Units = gross items. ASP = GMV ÷ units. MKD % = markdown discount ÷ normal price (AED). PC1 % = PC1 ÷ gross revenue. Prov. PC1 % = provisional PC1 ÷ gross revenue. Overall covers all countries, KSA and UAE included. Ratios are calculated from summed values. Change vs LY/LLY is % for value metrics and percentage points (pp) for % metrics. Today is excluded because the day is still in progress.
